Parallel motor power above · one paired RS485 bus below · shared DC ground

A/B daisy-chain · keep each pair together
Connect motor power through J1. Use J2 pins 1 / 2 / 3 for GND / A / B. No motor power from J2 logic rails.
20 V is nominal after PD negotiation. Verify J1 voltage and polarity before attaching motors.
Drawing is schematic; not to scale. Motor pigtail strip shows functions, not a connector mating-face view.
